subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan for GreenCart POC
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greencart.com>, Samir Patel <s.patel@greencart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan for GreenCart POC

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks for taking the call last week. As promised, attaching an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a lightweight SOW template to get alignment on scope and timelines for the POC. High-level intent: run a 4-week evaluation that validates latency and cost per request for your checkout recommendation flow, and demonstrates identical behavior between our hosted runtime and the private deployment option you asked about.

What Id like to achieve with this kickoff email:
- Confirm core stakeholders and single points of contact on both sides
- Lock target success criteria and a realistic close window (were targeting an early May decision)
- Assign owners for the technical readiness checklist and procurement items

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Review attached MAP and mark any missing milestones — please reply with edits by EOD Wednesday PST
2) Schedule a technical kickoff (30–45m) with your engineering lead and our SE / ML engineer — suggested slots below
3) Procurement: loop in your procurement contact so we can circulate an initial SOW/quote

Attachments: GC_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (11KB), SOW_template.docx (28KB)

Suggested meeting windows (PST): Tue 3/31 10:00–11:00, Wed 4/1 14:00–15:00, Thu 4/2 09:30–10:15

Thanks — happy to adjust.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Elena — thanks for the quick read. Looping in a concise owner-level plan so we have clear commitments: (Deal: GC-2026-0421)

MAP milestone summary (owners & target dates):
- MAP final review (GreenCart comments in doc): Owner - Elena / Samir — due 2026-04-01 EOD
- Technical kickoff and readiness checklist: Owner - Stephanie (Redwood SE) & Samir (GreenCart Eng) — meeting 2026-04-01 14:00 PST
- Security questionnaire / data-handling note: Owner - Rishi (Redwood ML Sec) & GreenCart Security — due 2026-04-05
- Procurement SOW review & initial commercial comments: Owner - GreenCart Procurement — due 2026-04-07
- POC execution window: 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-08
- Stakeholder decision (recommended close): target 2026-05-12

Quick asks for the kickoff meeting: please share Samirs list of representative sample requests (latency percentiles, sequence lengths, typical concurrency) so Stephanie can prepare a short perf-run playbook. Also flag any network/VPN constraints up-front.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + tech kickoff agenda (GreenCart POC)

Hi Samir / Elena —

Quick intro: Im Stephanie, Solutions Engineer on the Redwood team; Ill run the technical portion of the MAP and lead the perf/cost validation. Rishi (copied) will support model/ops questions and the security checklist.

Agenda for the 4/1 technical kickoff (30–45m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Workload profile review — typical sequences, request size, concurrency expectations (10m)
3) Evaluation plan: perf benchmarks, KV/prefix caching, and expected quantization tradeoffs (15m)
4) Infrastructure + network considerations for private deployment vs hosted (5–10m)
5) Action items & owners (5m)

Prep asks (please bring to the kickoff):
- Representative request logs or a CSV with sequence length distribution
- A short note on expected concurrency (peak RPS) and target p95 latency
- Security artifacts contact (who will get the security questionnaire)

Ive also attached a short tech checklist to speed the readiness review. If the suggested Wed 14:00 slot works, Ill send a calendar invite with dial-in + pre-read.

Attachments: tech-checklist.xlsx (6KB)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
